recon.contract_verified_against: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (fetched live this cycle, not from memory)
key_facts: PreToolUse hook receives JSON on stdin with tool_name, tool_input, cwd, hook_event_name
exit 0 + JSON {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName,permissionDecision,permissionDecisionReason}} on stdout is the recommended way to allow/deny, not exit codes alone
permissionDecision: 'deny' blocks, 'allow' bypasses normal permission flow, omitted = no decision

scope.in: Write and Edit tool calls to any path outside .pmcro/
scope.out: Bash tool calls (left ungated this cycle — a real, stated limitation, not an oversight; gating Bash would require command-intent parsing, which is a separate, larger plan)

plan.action: Write plugins/pmcro/hooks/hooks.json registering a PreToolUse hook on matcher "Write|Edit" pointing at a guard script.

Write plugins/pmcro/hooks/guard-log-before-act.js: reads the PreToolUse JSON payload from stdin, allows unconditionally when tool_input.file_path is under .pmcro/, otherwise scans .pmcro/trails/ (recursively, to cover .pmcro/trails/working/{uuid}) for any directory containing 00-frame.jsonl but no disposition.json; denies with an EC-SYS-003 message if none is found, otherwise emits no decision (falls through to normal permission flow).

Test the guard script directly (not via a live Claude Code hook invocation, which this session cannot trigger on itself) by piping synthetic PreToolUse JSON payloads into it via node and capturing real stdout + exit code for both branches.

acceptance_criteria.check: plugins/pmcro/hooks/hooks.json exists and is valid JSON registering PreToolUse on Write|Edit
acceptance_criteria.verify: file exists; JSON.parse succeeds; matcher field present

acceptance_criteria.check: guard-log-before-act.js exists and is executable via node with no syntax errors
Given a synthetic payload for tool_input.file_path under .pmcro/, the script emits no denial (falls through)
acceptance_criteria.verify: real command output, exit code 0, no permissionDecision:deny in stdout

acceptance_criteria.check: Given a synthetic payload for a non-.pmcro file_path with NO open trail present, the script denies citing EC-SYS-003
acceptance_criteria.verify: real command output: exit code 0, stdout JSON has permissionDecision:"deny" and reason mentions EC-SYS-003

acceptance_criteria.check: Given the same non-.pmcro file_path payload WITH an open trail present (this very trail, before it seals), the script does not deny
The script never throws on a malformed/empty stdin payload (fails open, not crashing)
acceptance_criteria.verify: real command output with empty stdin: exit code 0, no crash
